designLaws.name: Hierarchy is contrast, not size alone
Type must survive the font not loading
Dark mode inverts lightness, not the palette
The 8-point grid, with a 4-point half step
Density is a mode, not a value
Centre of gravity — *no ring of content around a void*
Density and emptiness are different failures
Ratio: one scale for space, one for type, one for size
Motion communicates or it does not ship
Duration scales with distance and size
Reduced motion is a requirement, and it preserves information
Never animate a property that forces layout
Focus is visible, and not obscured
Never rely on hover or pointer alone
Motion, contrast and text size are user settings
Personal and postal data have no universal shape
Every state has a forward action and a marked exit
Back is never destructive, and never a lie
Work is durable from the first meaningful action
An unfinished thing is findable without its URL
A step carries its own context
The state machine is explicit, and the user sees fewer states
Long flows are interruptible by design, not by accident
Every committed action is attributable and reconstructable
A dry run precedes an expensive commit
Time is shown where time matters
The end of a flow is designed
The server decides; the interface only reflects
Hide navigation, disable action, explain both
A page with nothing to do is not that page
Design for the smallest viable holder, then add
Permission state is not an error state
Granting is a design surface, not a data grid
Separation of duties is shown, not just enforced
Scope is part of the permission, and it is visible
A page is correct when a module it mentions is absent
The composition is data, never a conditional
No cross-module link without a fallback
The core is complete on its own
Brand is a value, branch is a row, sector is a folder
Multi-party screens name the party's side
An integration is a capability, not a brand
One component, many densities and surfaces — never a fork
Organise by job, not by org chart
Search is a first-class path, not a fallback
The current position is always stated
Every screen is reachable by clicking
Depth is a promise of specificity
The tree is composed, not authored
Recency and pinning belong to the user
A cross-surface concept keeps its place
Every image has a source, dimensions, and a fallback
Nothing overflows at any of the seven widths
Every screen is reachable by clicking
Every page renders with every module absent
Every page renders at minimum privilege
No layout depends on string length
Colour is never the only channel
Focus is never obscured, and never lost
Nothing is reachable by hover alone
A check that cannot run is a failing check
